messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 Incident (P1) — model-quality-regression detected for model `open-redwood-3b-v1` in prod. Alerting oncall. Symptoms: elevated hallucination rate on safety-critical prompts and customer-reported regressions. Ticket: INC-7341

jordan: just hit the pager. i'm on it. any immediate customer-visible impact?

emily: seeing ~10% increase in hallucination flags from internal eval set for the last 3 minutes. latency looks fine. a few customers pinged support about nonsense completions.

maria: support thread: customer A reported sensitive info hallucination in completions, thread id 9876. queued for T1.

jordan: ok prioritize rollback to previous pinned model `open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2`. we should pin default while we investigate. who can run the rollback?

ali: i can. prepping command now.

ops-bot: @ali — to execute a rollback, run:
```
redwood deploy rollback --model open-redwood-3b-v1 
--to-version open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2 
--scope prod 
--force 
```
Confirm with `yes` to proceed.

ali: running rollback in 1m. will post logs.

emily: also recommend enabling pinning for affected routes: set `model.pin = open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2` for the `chat` and `completion` routes.

ali: rollback started. logs: `rolling back model open-redwood-3b-v1 -> v0.9.2 (requested by ali)`

ops-bot: Rollback progress: 40% -> 85% -> complete. New traffic routed to open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2.

jordan: nice. can someone draft a status page update? short and clear.

maria: draft: 
"Status: Partial degradation (mitigated) — We detected a model quality regression affecting a subset of text generation requests. We have rolled back to a previous model version and are monitoring — some customers may have seen incorrect/misleading outputs between 14:22 and 14:31 UTC. No service outage. Impact: content quality. Mitigation: rollback completed at 14:35 UTC. Next updates: ongoing monitoring, postmortem in 24h."

emily: tweak: include affected model and guidance: say customers using `open-redwood-3b-v1` may have seen issues, advise pinning to `open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2` if they need stricter quality for now.

maria: updated status page text: 
"Status: Partial degradation (mitigated) — Between 14:22 and 14:35 UTC a model quality regression in `open-redwood-3b-v1` caused incorrect or misleading outputs for a subset of text generation requests. We have rolled back affected traffic to `open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2` at 14:35 UTC. If you rely on strict output quality, consider pinning to `open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2` until the next release. We are monitoring and will post a follow-up and postmortem within 24 hours."

jordan: good. maria, can you post that to status.redwood.ai?

maria: posting now. status page update posted. incident link: STATUS-1123.

ali: rollback verified. sampling shows hallucination rate returned to baseline.

emily: running additional evals on internal regression suite; will post results in ~10m.

jordan: customer comms — we should notify customers who explicitly reported issues + broad notice for affected customers. Draft a short email/snippet for support to send.

maria: customer notif draft (for Support):
"Hi <Customer>,
We wanted to let you know we detected and mitigated a model quality regression that may have affected your recent requests between 14:22 and 14:35 UTC. We rolled back the model to a prior version and have stabilized traffic. We’re continuing to monitor and will follow up with a detailed postmortem. If you saw any concerning outputs, please reply with examples and we’ll prioritize review. Apologies for the disruption.
— Redwood Support"

ali: small tweak: add remediation steps for customers building safety-critical flows: `recommend pinning model to open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2` and a pointer to docs: https://redwood.ai/docs/model-pinning

maria: updated and sent to Support queue. support team will reach out to affected customers (customer A + any others from logs).

emily: evals: internal regression suite shows metrics back to baseline at 14:42 UTC. attaching snippet: 
```
Model | hallucination_rate
open-redwood-3b-v1 (15:20-14:35) | 0.12
open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2 (post-rollback) | 0.03
```

jordan: solid. we'll keep monitoring for 1 hour. emily, ali — take 15min to run deeper checks on diffs (safety, toxicity, rouge vs reference).

ali: on it. running diff job.

ops-bot: @jordan — handing off to night oncall taylor at 17:00 UTC. Please include this thread summary in the handoff.

jordan: handoff summary (paste into oncall log):
- Incident INC-7341: Model-quality regression in `open-redwood-3b-v1` detected at 14:22 UTC.
- Impact: incorrect or misleading outputs for subset of text generation requests. Some customer reports.
- Mitigation: rolled back to `open-redwood-3b-v0.9.2` at 14:35 UTC, pinned default routes.
- Current status: mitigated; metrics back to baseline as of 14:42 UTC. Monitoring ongoing.
- Action items: run nightly safety sweep, coordinate postmortem, consider tagging release with hotfix flag.

taylor: acknowledged, i'll take the overnight watch and continue monitoring. please add any artifacts to the incident ticket.

maria: created postmortem draft skeleton in INC-7341 and added logs/commands + status page + customer templates. assigning to emily and jordan for write-up.

emily: ack, i'll start the root cause outline. initial suspicion: bad training mix or untested change in decoding defaults.

jordan: thanks team. closing comms for now. if anything spikes, reopen pager. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-7341 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring.

end of thread"
